messages:
chris: Repro: using Retrofit suspend adapter + OkHttp. Start request, trigger connectivity change, coroutine resumes on a different dispatcher and the same logical call executes twice -> duplicate POSTs and 401s.

chris: Minimal interceptor: 
```
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = TokenStore.getBlockingToken()
    return chain.proceed(chain.request().newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build())
  }
}
```

anya: Which coroutine dispatcher are you using? Switching dispatchers during suspend/resume can race with OkHttp's internal Call lifecycle.

chris: Default IO dispatcher. No custom CallAdapter. Happens most when device toggles WiFi->LTE quickly right after app cold start.

lee: Any minify/R8 enabled on debug APK? A past bug had R8 change coroutine bridge timing and surface this exact symptom.

chris: Ah — debug had minify accidentally. Turning it off drops dupes to near zero locally.

ci-bot: Note: filed issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/189 with logs and two APKs (minified/non-minified).

eng-runtime: We shipped an OkHttp dispatcher tweak recently; will pair with you on the APKs to rule out runtime vs bytecode interaction.

anya: Short fixes: 1) disable debug minify, 2) implement single-flight token refresh to dedupe inflight refreshes, 3) ensure TokenStore doesn't recreate OkHttpClient or reuse Request objects.

chris: Temp fix: turned off minify for debug and added proguard keep for auth packages. Scheduling pairing with eng-runtime. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
